title: The plague years: five centuries of plague, mapped year by year
excerpt: 6,848 recorded outbreak years in 1,172 towns, from the Black Death in 1347 to Porto in 1900: how plague spread, kept coming back about every 13 years, and left Europe a century before the Ottoman Mediterranean.
seo_description: An animated map of five centuries of plague in Europe and the Mediterranean, 1347 to 1900: the Black Death, the returns, and when plague left.
header_alt: Title card reading 'The plague years' in black and red on cream, beside a map of Europe and the Mediterranean covered in red dots sized by the number of years plague was recorded in each town, largest in London, Paris, Algiers and Izmir. Text: 6,848 outbreak years in 1,172 towns, 1347 to 1900.
